feedTitle: Shipping forecast for the North Irish Sea

items.title: Shipping forecast updated as of 2 October 2026 10:42pm
items.description:
##Current shipping forecast##

Valid for 24 HoursIssued on Friday, 02 October 2026 at 10:35pm by Ronaldsway Met Office
##Warning##

Nil.


##Synopsis##

Active cold front now clearing the Irish Sea area as high pressure builds to its rear.


##Wind##

West or Northwest 4 or 5, decreasing West 3 or 4 overnight, backing South or Southwest later tomorrow.


##State of Sea##

Moderate, becoming slight or moderate overnight, then slight tomorrow.


##Weather##

Rain in the far east at first soon clearing, then fair.


##Visibility##

Good, falling moderate in rain in the east at first.


##Outlook for the following 24 hours##


##Wind##

South or Southwest 3 or 4, increasing 4 or 5 overnight into Sunday, 5 occasionally 6 from later on Sunday morning onwards, although staying a force or two lighter in Liverpool Bay.


##State of Sea##

Slight, becoming slight or moderate.


##Weather##

Fair, then patchy light.


##Visibility##

Good, occasionally moderate in any rain.
